_readme: The team, in the order shown. Edit this file, then run: node tools/build-team.mjs
It writes /team/, one profile per person at /team/<slug>/ (or `out` if set), all from one template.

photo: a path under public/, e.g. /team-photos/fifi-ling.jpg (4:5 portrait, at least 800x1000). If it is left out, /team-photos/<slug>.jpg is used when that file exists; otherwise the card shows the person's initials.
work: the portfolio. Each item: { kind, title, text, href (optional), image (optional, a path under public/, 16:10), icon (optional, a product logo) }.
links: { label, text, href }. bio: paragraphs. focus: short tags.

people.name: Michael
bio: Michael founded M3XI and leads the company and the products that stem from it: Breeze and CallMe.

He is an engineer and a professional model, and studies Creative Robotics at University of the Arts London. Before M3XI he taught programming in primary schools, which is where the company's aim of making capable technology easy to pick up began.

work.title: Breeze
work.text: A fitness app with an AI coach that builds meal plans and daily workouts.

work.kind: Product · On Google Play · iPhone pre-order
work.title: CallMe
work.text: Video calls with ID-checked adults, and a way to keep in touch with the people you click with.

work.title: Model book
work.text: Modelling and performance: tailoring, digitals, London, and ARGOS on stage.

work.title: Work CV and Performance CV
work.text: Both CVs, as a page and as PDFs.
